text:
vikram.kumar: Quick announcement — rolling out a small L40s Dedicated preview in Lagos (ng-west-1) starting now. This is targeted at low-latency regional customers and edge partners. :tada:

amanda.choi: Nice! What does "preview" mean here for reservations and SLA?

vikram.kumar: Preview = limited pools, best-effort availability, no formal SLA yet. We're enabling a 14-day reservation window and a soft fair-share policy to avoid noisy neighbors.

sre-bot: [automated] pool-create: dedicated-l40s-ng-west-1-1 created (8x L40s) by infra-deploy. Monitoring: enabled.

josh.smith: Ops notes: these pools are preemptible for background burst reclaim. If a tenant has an active 14-day reservation it won't be preempted during that window. Non-reserved workloads may be reclaimed during Z-peaks.

sara_retail: Sales question — what quota should we promise customers for GA? Also what's the expected per-token cost delta vs our us-east L40s?

vikram.kumar: For GA we'll publish official quotas. For preview: suggest we tell customers "subject to availability, typical steady-state throughput ~65-70% of us-east due to smaller pool sizes." Cost: billable rate is the same; effective unit cost might be slightly higher until we add more nodes.

ops-team: TL;DR for runbooks:
```
1) Reserve: `rcli reserve --region ng-west-1 --gpu L40s --count 2 --days 14`
2) Check usage: `rcli pool status --name dedicated-l40s-ng-west-1-1`
3) Force-drain for patching: `rcli pool drain --name dedicated-l40s-ng-west-1-1 --eta 15m`
```

josh.smith: Important — autoscaling for these pools is disabled in preview. Do not rely on burst scaling for production traffic.

amanda.choi: Can we get a short README for account teams? I'll add it to the public launch checklist.

vikram.kumar: Yes — created a short FAQs doc in Confluence and pinged the linked customers. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated/ng-west-1-l40s-preview (internal)

sre-bot: [automated] metric alert created: l40s-ng-west-1-cpu-heatmap (warn at 80%, critical at 95%).

sara_retail: Noted. I'll hold pre-sales offers to enterprise accounts until GA. Small partners can try the preview with engineer support.

ops-team: Reminder: If you hit allocation limits, file a ticket with tag `dedicated-l40s-ng-west-1` and include your reservation id.

vikram.kumar: Follow-ups early next week — we'll share usage trends and a decision on burst/autoscale policy after 72h of telemetry. Thanks all. :rocket:
